# Video Edit

A smart router for editing existing video on RunComfy. Based on the intent, it picks one of three models and ships its documented prompting patterns: Wan 2.7 Edit-Video for general restyle, background swap or packaging swap with identity and motion preservation (video 2 to 10 s, up to 100 MB, up to 1080p, optional reference image), Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control to transfer precise motion from a reference video to a target character, or Lucy Edit Restyle for lightweight identity-stable outfit swaps and restyles capped at 720p. Every run goes through the local RunComfy CLI and is charged by RunComfy. One model per call, no multi-route blending.
